svg.aria-label: How a correction moves through memory: at 10:42 a coding session says to run the tests before every commit; at 10:45 note 241 records it and replaces note 187; at 03:30 the gardener edits one line of work-style.md in its own git commit citing memory:241; the next morning every agent's context_get carries it
